purpose: Answer what caused unnecessary production work today and choose one bounded measurable improvement.

boundedImprovementProposal.action: Generate headline candidates from the completed Story Dossier after the article body exists, then pre-score Actor + Action + Consequence and body overlap before editorial review.
boundedImprovementProposal.expectedOutcome: Improve first-pass publication and reduce repair loops during the next production window without lowering editorial standards.
boundedImprovementProposal.measurement: Compare firstPassPublicationRate, finalApprovalRate, repairFrequency, repeatedReasoning, and highQualityPublishedArticlesPerHour after the next production window.

failurePreventionMemory.writerInstruction: Before drafting, read the Story Dossier, Editorial Memory, Headline Pattern Memory, Learner Lexicon, and prevention rules; then reason internally about verified event, uncertainty, headline direction, and likely editorial risk before prose generation.

rules.preventBy: Use Actor + Action + Consequence from the completed event dossier and score body overlap before editorial review.
